title: Callimahos, Lambros D. "Communication with Extraterrestrial Intelligence." NSA Technical Journal Vol. XI, no. 1, September 23, 1965
doc_notes: This document is a technical article by Lambros D. Callimahos regarding the theoretical communication with extraterrestrial intelligence, focusing on mathematical and cryptographic methods for interstellar messaging; it contains no reports of actual UAP sightings or encounters.
